    About Solera in Lakewood Ranch

    Welcome to Solera, a vibrant and active community located in Lakewood Ranch. This community was designed with an active lifestyle in mind, offering endless opportunities to stay fit and have fun.

    Whether you're a fitness enthusiast or just looking for a way to stay active, Solera has something for everyone.

    ​

    But Solera isn't just about staying fit - it's also about enjoying life to the fullest. From social events and clubs to beautifully landscaped parks and nature trails, Solera offers a variety of ways to relax and have fun. And with a convenient location near top-rated schools, shopping centers, and entertainment venues, you'll never be far from the action.

    ​

    Speaking of convenience, Solera is just minutes away from all the amenities you need. From grocery stores and pharmacies to banks and gas stations, everything you need is right at your fingertips.

     

    Plus, with easy access to major roads and highways, you can easily explore all that Lakewood Ranch and the surrounding areas have to offer.

    ​

    Don't miss out on the chance to make Solera your new home - visit us today and see for yourself all that our community has to offer. From top-notch amenities and recreational activities to a convenient location and a sense of community, Solera has it all.
